debateChrome.scoring.graphScoredNoV2Endp: Scored on the graph — no V2 scoring endpoint

V3 scores every claim on the answer graph itself: each card carries its recorded base score and final strength, with the full labels and replay handles in each badge tooltip and claim drawer. What V3 has no resource for is V2's separate per-node scoring endpoint — so no scoring refresh, holes, fatal flags or score feedback exist here.
